legal.emergency: Biwadiumvua bibi, anyi sukadi wa mu mashi udi muinshi bikole anyi pulu bikole ne bimanyinu, kuindidi application to: bikila diambuluisha anyi ya ku tshiondo tshia manga tshia pa buipi.

disclaimer.title: Tshiamu tshia kuambuluisha, ki mubelu wa munganga to
disclaimer.short: Afyabora udi ukuambuluisha bua kulonda sukadi webe. Katshiena tshijadika disama to ne katshiena tshiangata muaba wa mubelu wa muena manga to.
disclaimer.intro: Afyabora ndi tshiamu tshia kuambuluisha mu dilonda dia diabète. Kumpala kua kutshienzeja, bidi bimpe kumanya tshidi tshienza, nangananga tshidi katshienzi to.

does.title: Tshidi Afyabora wenza
does.body: Udi ulama mapima ebe, nansha kakuyi internet. Udi wenza bungi bupepele kufumina ku malu ebe nkayebe (moyenne, tshikondo munda mua mikalu yebe mimpe, misangu ivua sukadi mubande anyi mupueke). Udi ukuambuluisha bua kulongolola dipetangana ne munganga ne kuabanya muyuki webe ne munganga uwasungula.

doesNot.title: Tshidi katshienzi to
doesNot.body: Katshiena tshijadika disama to. Katshiena tshifila dose wa insuline anyi wa manga to. Katshiena tshiamba bualu budi bubandisha anyi bupuekesha sukadi to: malu adi tshileja adi anu njila ya kuyukila ne muena manga.

quality.title: Mandamuna adi alonda malu audi ufunda
quality.body: Bungi budi bulelela anu bikala mapima malelela: bungi bufunda bibi anyi matuku kaayi ne dipima adi ashintulula mandamuna. Application udi ukumanyisha pikala malu makese bua kuangata dipangadika.

treatment.title: Manga ebe
treatment.body: Kushintulula manga ebe anu bua application to. Yukila kumpala ne munganga webe anyi bena manga bebe.

alerts.title: Bivulukishi ne dimanyisha
alerts.body: Bivulukishi ne dimanyisha bidi mua kubenga kulua (telefone mujime, batterie mujike, ba notification bakangibue). Kabiena biangata muaba wa ditabalela diebe ne dia bantu bebe to.

privacy.title: Mikenji ya bulami bua musokoko
privacy.intro: Malu a disama diebe adi aebe. Dibeji edi didi dileja patoke tshitudi tulama, bua tshinyi, penyi ne nganyi udi mua kutshimona.
privacy.prototype: Afyabora ndi katataka prototype muenza mu tshilongelu. Mikenji eyi neitangidibue kabidi ne bakokeshi kumpala kua kumufila kudi bantu bonso.

data.title: Malu adi alamibua
data.body: Compte webe: adresse email ne mot de passe (kalamibu patoke nansha kakese to). Profil webe: dina, dituku dia kuledibua, mulume anyi mukaji, mushindu wa diabète, tshidimu tshiakamumonabu, unité ne mikalu iwasungula. Biwasua: muntu wa mu diku wa kumanyisha ne munganga webe. Dilonda diebe: mapima a sukadi, bienzedi (biakudia, mudimu wa mubidi, manga…) ne ba note.

purpose.title: Bua tshinyi
purpose.body: Anu bua dilonda diebe: kuleja muyuki webe, kuenza bungi buebe ne kulongolola dipetangana ne munganga. Piblisite kayena to. Malu ebe kaapanyibu nansha kakese to.

storage.title: Penyi padiwu alamibua
storage.body: Kumpala mu telefone webe, bua kuenza mudimu nansha kakuyi internet, panyima ku serveur wetu pikala internet. Ditumangana didi mu musokoko, ba note bebe badi mu musokoko ku serveur, ne udi mua kukanga application ne code anyi tshiala. Paudi upatuka, malu adi amushibua mu telefone.

sharing.title: Kuabanya ne munganga
sharing.body: Kakuena tshiabanyibua kuwakutshienza to. Wewe udi wenza QR code, udi wenza mudimu tshikondo tshikese ne musangu umue anu; anu munganga mubuele ne muitabujibue ke udi mua kumubala. Wewe udi usungula tshiamona ne bua tshikondo tshinyi, udi mua kulekela diabanya misangu yonso, ne ditangila dionso didi dimueneka mu kalasa webe.

emergency.title: Carte wa ntatu
emergency.body: Biwamubulula, carte wa ntatu udi mua kubalibua nansha kakuyi compte: ke tshipatshilu tshiende, bua bena diambuluisha. Udi anu ne malu auwasungula, ki muyuki webe to. Misangu yonso udi mubululuke, badi bakumanyisha, ne udi mua kumukanga anyi kumushintulula misangu yonso.

analysis.title: Dikonkonona
analysis.body: Bungi ne malu adi amueneka bidi bienzibua kudi application ne mikenji kayi ishintuluka ne idi mua kutangidibua, anu kufumina ku malu ebe. Dituku dimue tshiamu bu tshilongolola mifundu, netshipete anu bungi bukese, kakuyi dina diebe ne adresse webe to.

retention.title: Bua tshikondo tshinyi
retention.body: Malu ebe adi alamibua bitu compte webe udiku. Diumbusha dia compte didi diumbusha malu ebe ku ba serveur betu.

rights.title: Makokeshi ebe
rights.body: Udi mua kupeta copie wa malu ebe, kualongolola ne kuumbusha compte webe. Dianyisha diuvua mufile paudi wenza compte didi mua kumushibua biwaumbusha compte webe. Kuena ne bua kuabanya malu ebe ne munganga to.
